description: Access Point - Networking hardware device allowing Wi-Fi devices to connect to a wired network.
Wireless Access Point - Device configured to transmit and receive RF signals for wireless device access.
Service Set Identifier - Unique technical name broadcasting and identifying a specific 802.11 wireless network.
Basic Service Set Identifier - MAC address of the radio interface of a specific Wireless Access Point.
Wi-Fi Protected Access - Intermediate wireless security protocol created to fix severe security flaws in WEP.
Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 - Standard wireless security protocol implementing robust AES-CCMP encryption.
Wi-Fi Protected Access 3 - Modern wireless protocol introducing SAE authentication and enhanced key protection.
Wired Equivalent Privacy - Legacy 802.11 security protocol broken due to weak initialization vectors.
Wi-Fi Protected Setup - Insecure wireless network setup feature vulnerable to brute-force PIN calculation attacks.
Pre-Shared Key - Shared passphrase used for Wi-Fi authentication in WPA/WPA2 Personal mode.
Simultaneous Authentication of Equals - Secure key exchange protocol replacing PSK in WPA3 to defeat offline dictionary attacks.
Radio-Frequency Identification - Technology using electromagnetic fields to identify and track tags attached to objects.
Near-Field Communication - Short-range wireless standard allowing communication within 4 cm for mobile payments.
Bluetooth Low Energy - Power-conserving variant of Bluetooth designed for low-bandwidth IoT sensor applications.
